description: Two square oscillators, one hard-syncing the other, both driven by a starve voltage that sets the output level as well as the pitch

params.text: Sets the frequency of the main oscillator between 120Hz and 1885Hz, reaching the top of that range halfway round and going no further
Sets the frequency of the oscillator that hard-syncs the main one, between 10Hz and 3000Hz, reaching the top of that range halfway round

inputs.text: The starve voltage, read between 0 and 5V: it drags both oscillator frequencies down and scales the output, and it is slew limited before it reaches the pitch

outputs.text: The main oscillator's square wave, smoothed by a one-pole lowpass and scaled by the starve voltage

notes: With nothing patched into the starve input the module is silent, because that voltage is the output level as well as a pitch control.

inputs.0:
0 to 5V · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
